summary: Full E2E regression on WorkHop. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests passed (leads preview, employer unlock with 5 leads, freelancer pay, aadhaar 400/404/dummy validations + success masking, submit >3 images 400, submit unknown 404, submit success). Frontend: landing role toggle works; employer screen renders 5 lead cards with blurred name/phone/portfolio overlays, unlock banner + CTA opens bottom sheet, pay-confirm triggers loader then unblurs all cards and shows unlocked-badge; freelancer wizard step1 pay enables step2/3/4 (opacity 0.4 -> 1, pointerEvents toggles), aadhaar verify returns masked, linkedin+portfolio inputs editable, 3 portfolio slots toggle filled, submit shows processing-overlay with bouncing kangaroo and 'Your profile will leap live within 2 hours.' text. All testIDs present and used.

useNativeDriver:true logs 'RCTAnimation missing' on web — set useNativeDriver:false on web or leave (non-blocking, animation still works via JS fallback)
